name: AMD Integrated GPU - Use Swangle Rendering (Example)
author: ApkBolt
description: On some older AMD integrated GPUs and legacy graphics drivers, host GPU acceleration passes self-check but guest crashes after boot. Forcing swangle rendering avoids the crash with slightly reduced framerate.

notes: If graphics render normally but games stutter, adjust resolution to 540x960 in Settings
Set enabled to true or remove the flag once verified to take effect automatically
